notes: Seven web searches ran; none was refused. Search results on her and AI were thin, so the search may be incomplete. The statement date is the article date (23 July 2025); the interview itself may have been a few days earlier. The article also paraphrases her calling for increased safeguards on AI in military weapons and saying neither the Pentagon nor Musk responded; these are left out as paraphrases. The letter she led is not quoted and its co-signers and date are not given in the article. Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538, introduced by Rep. Casar on 24 September 2026): search results gave conflicting cosponsor lists and none named Friedman; the Congress.gov cosponsor list was not checked directly. No House letter about AI risk signed or led by her was found (the many-signer August and September 2026 letters were not searched, per instructions). The first three pages of her official press releases (about June to October 2026) were checked by title; none were about AI. The official site's search page returned no results, so older releases were not fully checked. One search result wrongly described her as a California Assembly member; she was in the Assembly before joining Congress in January 2025.
